explanation: It fires only at D1, where it is about 10 (sometimes 4-8) when the previous trial was a2 that went rare to S1 and was rewarded; a rare S2 reached from a1 does not trigger it. Every GO and D2 step is 0, and so is D1 after an unrewarded trial, while D1 after other rewarded trials is usually 0, sometimes 1-2 (mostly late in the episode after rewarded a2 trials) and occasionally 2-7 after a rewarded a1-to-S1 trial.
